what: HIGH (code audit CA-A01-021, MEASURED): _adopt_orphan_position and _reattach_adopted_orphans unconditionally overwrite order_packages.linked_trade_id with the orphan row, so a PAPER-account orphan (e.g. bybit_portfolio, which mirrors bybit_2's trades exactly) steals the package link from the open REAL-MONEY trade, violating the BL-20260729 'link points at the real trade' invariant; the package is also reopened even if it was closed. LOCATION: src/runtime/order_monitor.py:L4087-L4091, L4351-L4356 (matcher L3948 is symbol-only; order_packages has no account_id column). PROPOSED FIX: Only set linked_trade_id when it is NULL or points at a non-open trade (update_order_package_linked_trade_if_unset semantics); never override a real-money link from a paper account; rely on trades.order_package_id for the orphan leg.
